name: Settlement Parties 35 Choice
definition: Provides details on either the delivering or receiving parties.

DeliveringSettlementParties.name: Delivering Settlement Parties
DeliveringSettlementParties.definition: Chain of parties involved in the settlement of a transaction, including receipts and deliveries, book transfers, treasury deals, or other activities, resulting in the movement of a security or amount of money from one account to another.

ReceivingSettlementParties.name: Receiving Settlement Parties
ReceivingSettlementParties.definition: Chain of parties involved in the settlement of a transaction, including receipts and deliveries, book transfers, treasury deals, or other activities, resulting in the movement of a security or amount of money from one account to another.
